A '''Wanderer''' was a commuter [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] that carried six passengers. [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] agents [[Hart-and-Parn Gorra-Fiolla|Fiolla]] and [[Magg]] used one of these for transport during the former's attempt to break up a [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] ring run by [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]] and, unknown to Fiolla at the time, Magg himself. During their transit to [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]], their Wanderer was rendered inoperable, so it was deposited in a CSA pool hangar while it waited for parts and repairs.<ref name="HSR" />
